title: Connector expiring invitation v2
description: POST /api/admin/invitation/create on the Connector proxies to POST /{product_id}/internal/v2/connector-invitation/ on the authenticated WebService loopback management listener. Same loopback Host, actual loopback peer, 32-byte backend key, absent Origin/backend proof on the internal hop, and exact Connector admin Origin/header are required. Default TTL is 3600 seconds, matching the C++ default. URL token and temporary password authorize the same enabled protocols until expires_at; neither is the primary password. Secrets are returned only in this authorized response, kept out of logs, public snapshots and HTTP URL queries. Links carry token in #invite=, removed by the browser before JSON login. Password and linked sessions cannot renew beyond invitation expiry. Private persisted records contain digests only and are invalidated by password rotation or explicit protocol/master disable. Errors: 400 invalid TTL/body, 403 boundary, 405 method, 429 64 active invitations, 500 storage failure. Invitations never grant access to local management.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 UTC exclusive deadline for both credentials and resulting invitation access.
